meta.title: CineMind — User-to-data system flow
meta.note: Views are authored paths through the current product boundaries. They are intentionally focused rather than an exhaustive runtime trace.

nodes.label: User action
nodes.detail: The user starts one focused product action. The diagram follows what that action becomes after it crosses each boundary.
nodes.record: No database write yet

nodes.label: Catalog shell
nodes.detail: App.jsx owns catalog loading, filters, title selection and the transition into a title interaction.
nodes.record: Keeps view state and catalog response in memory

nodes.label: Title detail
nodes.detail: RatingModal captures the half-point rating and watch duration that become one signal mutation.
nodes.record: Optimistic title state before server receipt

nodes.label: Auth / profile
nodes.detail: Auth surfaces submit credentials and recover the authenticated interaction owner after /me succeeds.
nodes.record: Account state is reflected in the browser owner namespace

nodes.label: catalogService
nodes.detail: Calls the catalog API through the configured base URL, applies timeout handling and returns normalized title records.
nodes.record: No direct write; returns catalog rows to React

nodes.label: authService
nodes.detail: Calls login and /me with cookie credentials, then coordinates owner promotion and pending interaction recovery.
nodes.record: Reads auth state and moves pending browser entries between owner namespaces

nodes.label: interactionService
nodes.detail: Creates mutation metadata, sends paced batches, retries recoverable failures and hydrates the server receipt into the UI.
nodes.record: Reads and acknowledges owner-scoped outbox entries

nodes.label: interactionStore
nodes.detail: Stores per-owner pending entries, signal snapshots, session proof and the durable anonymous-to-account transfer intent.
nodes.record: localStorage/sessionStorage namespaces; not PostgreSQL

nodes.label: recommendationService
nodes.detail: Builds Preview Picks and related rails from catalog records plus the latest acknowledged interaction timestamps.
nodes.record: Derived local view; no separate recommendation table

nodes.label: API middleware
nodes.detail: Applies transport, request-size, trusted-proxy, CSRF and IP/principal rate-limit policy before route logic.
nodes.record: Rejects invalid requests before a repository transaction

nodes.label: Catalog routes
nodes.detail: Validates filters and response shape, then delegates catalog reads to CatalogService.
nodes.record: Read-only request boundary

nodes.label: Interaction routes
nodes.detail: Requires account auth for signals, accepts optional auth for search/state and maps service errors to stable HTTP responses.
nodes.record: Binds session_id, proof token and mutation metadata

nodes.label: Auth routes
nodes.detail: Runs secure-transport and rate-limit preflight, then returns an HttpOnly cookie-backed auth state.
nodes.record: Response exposes user and interaction_session_id, not raw session tokens

nodes.label: Admin route
nodes.detail: Keeps reset outside the public product path and requires admin credentials plus an atomic limiter decision.
nodes.record: Maintenance command, not user interaction telemetry

nodes.label: CatalogService
nodes.detail: Uses one normalized filter set for count and page rows so the catalog response is internally consistent.
nodes.record: No write; shapes a stable read model

nodes.label: InteractionService
nodes.detail: Checks session ownership, mutation scope, device ordering and repair provenance before committing a signal.
nodes.record: One signal owns one watch row and one rating row

nodes.label: AuthService
nodes.detail: Normalizes login identifiers, verifies credentials, creates opaque sessions and attaches an accepted anonymous interaction session.
nodes.record: Creates auth session and may set interaction.sessions.user_id

nodes.label: ResetService
nodes.detail: Chooses current-session or full-account reset and delegates ordered cleanup to the admin repository.
nodes.record: Preserves catalog and ops data while clearing selected interaction/auth rows

nodes.label: CatalogRepository
nodes.detail: Executes parameterized count and list queries and joins normalized catalog relations.
nodes.record: Reads catalog.titles and relation tables

nodes.label: InteractionRepository
nodes.detail: Locks mutation IDs, performs idempotent inserts, resolves latest state and links repair provenance in PostgreSQL.
nodes.record: Writes search_events, watch_sessions and ratings

nodes.label: AuthRepository
nodes.detail: Resolves email/username aliases, stores password/session hashes and attaches or ends interaction sessions.
nodes.record: Writes auth.users, auth.sessions and interaction.sessions ownership

nodes.label: AdminRepository
nodes.detail: Neutralizes rating links and repair rows before deleting source session data, preserving foreign-key integrity.
nodes.record: Deletes or neutralizes scoped interaction/auth rows

nodes.label: catalog schema
nodes.detail: Normalized title metadata is the source for catalog pages, filters and local recommendation rails.
nodes.record: catalog.titles · title_genres · title_cast · title_countries · title_directors

nodes.label: interaction schema
nodes.detail: Durable interaction telemetry is stored with session scope, mutation identity, client time, device stream and repair provenance.
nodes.record: interaction.sessions · search_events · watch_sessions · ratings

nodes.label: auth schema
nodes.detail: Account identity and opaque cookie-session hashes are kept separate from browser JavaScript and interaction payloads.
nodes.record: auth.users · auth.sessions · interaction.sessions.user_id

nodes.label: ops schema
nodes.detail: Operational provenance records schema migrations, dataset sources, ingestion runs and quality issues.
nodes.record: ops.schema_migrations · dataset_sources · ingestion_runs · data_quality_issues

nodes.label: Catalog preparation
nodes.detail: Preparation code normalizes source rows, resolves poster assets and records ingestion outcomes before the app serves catalog data.
nodes.record: Feeds catalog schema and ops audit; not a user request

views.label: Catalog discovery
views.note: A search stays read-only: the user action becomes a parameterized catalog query, then a local recommendation view.

steps.label: search / filter
steps.detail: The user enters a query or selects a catalog filter.

steps.label: load page
steps.detail: App.jsx delegates loading and normalization to catalogService.

steps.label: GET /api/catalog
steps.detail: The client sends the request through the configured API boundary.

steps.label: validated request
steps.detail: Transport, CORS, request-size and proxy rules run before the route.

steps.label: page use case
steps.detail: The route validates filters and calls CatalogService.

steps.label: count + list
steps.detail: CatalogService keeps count and page queries on the same normalized filters.

steps.label: parameterized SELECT
steps.detail: PostgreSQL reads catalog.titles and normalized relation tables. No interaction row is written.

steps.label: catalog rows
steps.detail: The normalized response returns to the browser and becomes the catalog read model.

steps.label: derive rails
steps.detail: recommendationService ranks local discovery rails from catalog records and acknowledged timestamps.

views.label: Rating becomes telemetry
views.note: Follow one rating + watch action from optimistic UI to the exact PostgreSQL rows that receive it.

steps.label: rate + watch
steps.detail: The user chooses a rating and records watch duration in the title detail modal.

steps.label: queue signal
steps.detail: The UI creates an optimistic signal and sends it to interactionService.

steps.label: persist outbox
steps.detail: The owner-scoped entry keeps mutation ID, session, device stream and client sequence across reloads.

steps.label: retry / hydrate
steps.detail: Online state and the sync loop read pending entries, then overlay or replace them with server receipts.

steps.label: POST /signals
steps.detail: A signal batch crosses the secure transport, CSRF, body-size and rate-limit boundary.

steps.label: auth + proof
steps.detail: The route requires account auth and verifies the interaction session proof.

steps.label: record_signal
steps.detail: The route delegates the composite watch-plus-rating mutation.

steps.label: transaction + locks
steps.detail: The service checks ownership, idempotency scope, device ordering and repair provenance before writing.

steps.label: insert / reconcile
steps.detail: The transaction writes interaction.watch_sessions and interaction.ratings, retaining mutation and receipt metadata.

steps.label: server receipt
steps.detail: After a fulfilled signal batch, the client hydrates serverSavedAt so recommendation recency uses committed time.

views.label: Anonymous to account
views.note: The account boundary creates the cookie session, attaches the accepted interaction session and preserves pending browser data.

steps.label: login / register
steps.detail: The user submits credentials while an anonymous interaction session may still contain pending signals.

steps.label: credential request
steps.detail: The auth surface delegates cookie authentication and promotion to authService.

steps.label: journal first
steps.detail: The browser persists the anonymous-to-account transfer intent before changing the owner namespace.

steps.label: POST /login
steps.detail: Credentials and the anonymous session proof cross the secure auth boundary.

steps.label: rate-limited request
steps.detail: Auth route dependencies enforce secure transport and atomic login-attempt capacity.

steps.label: resolve principal
steps.detail: AuthService normalizes the identifier, verifies the password and creates the authenticated session.

steps.label: create + attach
steps.detail: The service asks AuthRepository to create the cookie session and attach an accepted anonymous interaction session.

steps.label: auth.users + sessions
steps.detail: PostgreSQL stores the account and hashed auth session; the raw cookie token is not stored.

steps.label: set owner
steps.detail: The accepted interaction.sessions row receives user_id so existing telemetry belongs to the account.

steps.label: copy pending data
steps.detail: After the response, the client copies anonymous outbox entries into the account namespace and retries durable recovery when needed.

views.label: Reset and provenance
views.note: Maintenance cleanup is scoped and ordered: repair provenance is handled before source rows disappear, while catalog and ops remain intact.

steps.label: request reset
steps.detail: An operator invokes the protected maintenance path rather than a public interaction endpoint.

steps.label: Basic Auth + limit
steps.detail: The admin route is protected by credentials and an atomic rate-limit decision.

steps.label: choose scope
steps.detail: ResetService selects current-session cleanup or full-account cleanup.

steps.label: ordered cleanup
steps.detail: AdminRepository executes the dependency-aware SQL sequence.

steps.label: clear telemetry
steps.detail: Repair rating links and repair watch rows are neutralized before source interaction rows are deleted.

steps.label: clear account scope
steps.detail: Full reset removes users and auth sessions; current-session reset leaves other account sessions alone.

steps.label: preserve catalog
steps.detail: Reset does not delete catalog titles or normalized relations.

steps.label: preserve provenance
steps.detail: Migrations and ingestion audit remain available for reproducibility and readiness checks.

cards.title: Read path
items: UI delegates to a client service
FastAPI route delegates to a backend service

cards.title: Write path
items: Outbox keeps pending intent durable in the browser
InteractionService validates owner and mutation scope
One signal commits watch and rating rows together

cards.title: Stored evidence
items: Session and account ownership stay explicit
Client mutation and device ordering metadata are retained
Repair rows carry provenance for mining and reset
